cap_selection: Finite proposed policy ceilings; clocks derived from unchanged1200/6600/120s worker source plus bounded observations and explicit conservative headroom. Native/import/history/host/worker resource fit NOT_DETERMINED.

allocation_live_bytes.unit: conservatively reserved live host buffers/strings/containers/cache/output, after trusted baseline

cache_insert_bytes.unit: actual data bytes at each successful host cache insertion

cache_insertions.unit: every successful host immutable-data cache insertion including reinsertion

cache_live_bytes.unit: simultaneously retained host cache data bytes

cache_live_objects.unit: simultaneously retained host immutable-data cache objects

command_chars.unit: codepoints in fixed trusted host argv, never credential-bearing

comparison_bytes.unit: length of both actual operands of every literal comparison, including repeats

diagnostic_bytes.unit: retained sanitized host diagnostics; no secret body/argv

entry_visits.unit: every returned tree/diff/directory/ref/index entry on every visit

file_read_bytes.unit: all actual host filesystem bytes including copies/metadata/installed/object inputs

file_write_bytes.unit: all actual host filesystem output bytes including every copy

git_input_bytes.unit: all actual bytes sent to host Git stdin

git_operations.unit: every actually started host Git process, including failures

git_output_bytes.unit: all actual stdout plus stderr bytes from host Git including framing/failures

metadata_read_bytes.unit: actual Git/ref/index/config/installation metadata input; subset of file_read_bytes

network_input_bytes.unit: all actual request body bytes, including token bodies, not persisted

network_output_bytes.unit: all received headers/body/transport diagnostic bytes before decoding

network_requests.unit: all actual API/transport request attempts including authentication/renewal/retry

object_copy_bytes.unit: actual copied owned object/pack/index bytes; subset of file_write_bytes

path_chars.unit: decoded literal normalized path codepoints; before insertion

physical_paths.unit: anchored store instance plus normalized absolute physical path; no OID/inode/owner deduplication

process_group_rss_bytes.unit: aggregate resident memory of installed HOST S/D/C brokers and HOST helpers including their baselines; enrolled NATIVE and unchanged WORKER payload domains remain independent under existing guards; no unclassified escape

process_operations.unit: all started HOST children including D/C brokers, Git/signing/helpers; excludes enrolled native/unchanged worker payload starts; one cumulative invocation

result_bytes.unit: complete UTF8 full terminal host record before publication

signing_operations.unit: all signing process starts, also process_operations

single_blob_bytes.unit: immutable or physical size of one literal content source

single_metadata_bytes.unit: full size of any one metadata source before reading

tracked_entries_per_snapshot.unit: complete tracked entries in each checkout or bare tree snapshot

worklist_entries.unit: simultaneously queued and in-progress metadata/path/entry records

named_phase_deadline: same absolute invocation route deadline; first-to-last intervals include every wait and reentry, never reset
network_transport_git: HTTPS final clone/fetch is additionally a host Git process and metered import; stream bytes also network counters; no ambient credential/helper
